message.reasoning:
I need to decide whether to buy or auction the property at CONNECTICUT_AVENUE.

I have $726 and own two of the three pink properties. I am not yet in a monopoly. The other players are cash-poor, so I can afford to buy this property outright.

The light blue group is split three ways. No player can complete it without trading. Virginia Avenue is the next unowned property needed to finish the pink set.

I am weighing the trade-offs of buying Connecticut. It would block p3 from completing the light blue set, but it also costs $120 that I could save for Virginia Avenue and pink houses instead.

Auctioning risks p3 or p4 acquiring the property for under $120. Standard strategy favors buying when cash is healthy. After the purchase, $606 remains, enough to buy Virginia and build four pink houses.
